_note: Draft review cases for the OpenAI submission. Run each one with the deployed plugin before submitting; adjust prompts to match what actually works.

positive.description: Measure a user's own pre-AI writing
positive.prompt: Here are three essays I wrote in 2018, before I used any AI tools. Measure my writing style. [paste three essays]
positive.expected_behavior: Asks or confirms that AI did not help write each piece, calls analyze_writing with ai_touched='no', and reports measured features such as sentence length, contractions per 1,000 words and question share as exact numbers.

positive.description: Build a profile with two writing modes
positive.prompt: These four are opinion pieces and these four are personal essays, all written by me before AI. Build my voice profile. [paste eight pieces]
positive.expected_behavior: Labels the samples with two registers, calls build_voice_profile, shows the ranges per register and the cross-check, and tells the user to save the returned profile.

positive.description: Check a draft against a saved profile
positive.prompt: Here's my voice profile and a LinkedIn post I drafted. Does it sound like my opinion-piece voice? [paste profile JSON and draft]
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_draft with the chosen register, then lists each failed feature with the direction to move (for example, 'sentences too uniform: add some under 8 words').

positive.description: Compare a sample with public-domain authors
positive.prompt: Which classic author does my writing style sit closest to? [paste one paragraph of 6+ sentences]
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_to_authors with the text and names the three closest authors and what they share, noting that this compares measured style only, not personality or quality.

positive.description: Rewrite an AI draft into the user's voice and verify it
positive.prompt: Rewrite this AI-written paragraph so it matches my profile's 'argue' register, and check it. [paste profile and paragraph]
positive.expected_behavior: Rewrites while keeping the facts, calls check_draft on the rewrite, and revises until it is in band or explains the remaining failed checks.

negative.description: AI-generated writing offered as the source
negative.prompt: Build my voice profile from these ChatGPT drafts I generated last week.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not measure them. Explains that AI-assisted text measures the assistant's version of the writer, and asks for writing done without AI. If the tool is called, it returns every sample as skipped.

negative.prompt: Here are my coworker's emails. Build a personality profile so I can tell my manager what she's like.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines. The tools measure a user's own writing style for their own drafting, and are not for assessing other people or for employment decisions.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call any Voice Profile tool.
